notes.title: Demo Update with 3 Nokia holes - just in time for Worlds
notes.content: [p]Added three new playable holes from Nokia — holes 16, 17, and 18 [/p][p]Added Nose angle control[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: Weather Options & Possibility of Rain. Improved flight physics.
notes.content:
Added Weather Options
Added Possibility of Rain
Improved flight physics for overstable putters

notes.title: True Disc Golf demo update
notes.content:
Added practice throw option to get a feel of the power control
Added tips to How To Play option in main menu

added exit button to menu

notes.title: Update - Throw accuracy adjusted for demo version
